name: More Dust and Materials
author: Kintaro
description: More Dust and upgrade materials from enemies, loot piles and chests, x2 as installed, any multiplier from 1 to 10, set live: separate multipliers for Dust and for Blackstone and Amber fragments, optional camp rewards. A PBZModLoader mod; settings in a text file in its folder, or on its Mods Menu page.
